OpenAI Data Exporter

Local MD and PDF exporter with full-size embedded images

Local HTML tool exporting each OpenAI chat to MD/PDF, saving original images and attachments to Assets. No uploads, backend or telemetry. Supports ZIP64/2GB+ exports and optional post-processing that leaves generated files untouched.

GitHub:
https://github.com/zivanovicmarko-stack/OpenAI-Data-Exporter
